summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near North Lynn, King's Lynn, with a 1.6 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294H INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
524606N 0002408E (NORTH LYNN, KINGS LYNN). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT 
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH 
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF 
SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL 
OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE 
OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO 
AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-8329/03.
